text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To become an Umamusume who can
surpass even
the Emperor Symboli
Rudolf...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During her crucial first three years
racing, Tokai
Teio has achieved that
ambitious dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio once again makes her
entrance by
bounding over the track's
fence.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'm about to start a new
chapter with
you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
After everything that happened in the
last three
years, I knew we'd both want
to keep this
partnership going...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But even so, I needed to hear it straight
from you
to make sure, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You're the one that helped me obtain
my dream.
So, I need you by my side!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
After all, I've got a new dream I wanna
go after
now!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I wanna keep racing with you
forever and
ever!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm off! Time to start training!
